Paragraph: He is the minister of that noteworthy soul and king of monkeys, Sugreeva, whom alone I cherish, but he himself has drawn near me on his own.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Rama recognizes with relief and gladness that the very ally he sought has approached him unprompted.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama openly acknowledges his longing (for an ally) and his relief at its fulfillment.
Outcome/Resolution: Rama's hope for alliance finds early confirmation.
Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Rama perceives this meeting as daiva-yoga, a providentially timed convergence answering an unspoken need.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Reflects relief from isolation - Rama's implicit loneliness in exile is eased by the unsolicited arrival of a potential ally.
